exposure: weaning food before four months of age
cohort: 317 Egyptian infants with CMPA (175 males, 55.2%) with a mean age at presentation of 4.2 +/- 3.2 months.
finding: Gastrointestinal symptoms were the main manifestations of CMPA, and parent's food allergy, cesarean section, and early weaning (<4 months) were independent risk factors for CMPA, while exclusive breastfeeding and late weaning (>6 months) were protective.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was an independent risk factor for CMPA.
